sentences.text: Amy Lou Adams -LRB- born August 20 , 1974 -RRB- is an American actress and singer .
She was named one of 100 most influential people by Time magazine in 2014 and is among the highest-paid actresses in the world .	100 most influential people	Time 100	Time	Time (magazine)

She has won two Golden Globe Awards , and has been nominated for five Academy Awards and six British Academy Film Awards .	Academy Awards	Academy Awards	British Academy Film Awards	British Academy Film Awards

Adams began her career on stage performing in dinner theater and went on to make her feature film debut in Drop Dead Gorgeous -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .	dinner theater	dinner theater	Drop Dead Gorgeous	Drop Dead Gorgeous (film)

After moving to Los Angeles , she made several appearances on television and in B-movies , before starring in Steven Spielberg 's 2002 biopic Catch Me If You Can .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Steven Spielberg	Steven Spielberg	Catch Me If You Can	Catch Me If You Can

Adams 's breakthrough role came in the 2005 independent film Junebug , in which her portrayal of a young pregnant woman earned her an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress nomination .	Junebug	Junebug (film)	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
In 2007 , she starred as a princess in the commercially successful Disney musical film Enchanted .	Disney	Disney	Enchanted	Enchanted (film)

Adams received three more Oscar nominations for her supporting roles in Doubt -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , The Fighter -LRB- 2010 -RRB- , and The Master -LRB- 2012 -RRB- .	Doubt	Doubt (2008 film)	The Fighter	The Fighter	The Master	The Master (2012 film)

She played reporter Lois Lane in the 2013 superhero film Man of Steel and a troubled con artist in David O. Russell 's film American Hustle ; for the latter , she won a Golden Globe Award and was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actress .
